qa_pairs.question: When performing scaling tests for Ansys Additive Manufacturing on a cluster, what methods can be used to prevent solutions from being overwritten between test runs?
qa_pairs.answer: To prevent solutions from being overwritten when performing scaling tests for Ansys Additive Manufacturing on a cluster, you can either modify your Slurm script by changing `Save(Overwrite=True)` to `Save(Overwrite=False)` or create a copy of the original `.wbpj` project file and its associated `_files` directory before each test run.

qa_pairs.question: How can a single Ansys Additive Manufacturing replay file be adapted for use across multiple different project directories on a cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: A single Ansys Additive Manufacturing replay file can be adapted for use in different project directories on a cluster by opening it in a text editor and modifying its internal `FilePath` setting to match the respective test case directory. After loading the appropriate Ansys module and removing any old lock files, the replay file can then be executed using a command like `runwb2 -R myreplay.wbjn`.
